:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.9`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noExpectToHaveBeenCalledOnce`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has a [**safe**](/linter/#safe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`test`](/linter/domains#test)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`vitest/prefer-called-times`](https://github.com/vitest-dev/eslint-plugin-vitest/blob/main/docs/rules/prefer-called-times.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExpectToHaveBeenCalledOnce": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow `toHaveBeenCalledOnce()` in favor of `toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)`.

Vitest provides `toHaveBeenCalledOnce()` and its alias `toBeCalledOnce()` to check that
a mock function (a fake function that records how it is called) was called exactly once.
`toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)` and `toBeCalledTimes(1)` make the same check.

`toHaveBeenCalledTimes()` works for any number of calls, so using it for a single call
keeps every check of a call count in the same form.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
expect(sendEmail).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
```

### Valid

```js
expect(sendEmail).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
expect(sendEmail).toBeCalledTimes(1);
expect(sendEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
```
